question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Amazon)

calls.reasoning: Consensus Q3 2026 EPS is about $1.96-2.03 (Q3 2025: $1.95). Q3 operating income guide is $22.5-26.5B against Q2's realized $27.5B; at a 17% tax rate and 10.9B diluted shares, $25-28B operating income implies $1.90-2.15 core EPS, and Amazon usually lands near or above the top of its guide. Q1 ($2.78) and Q2 ($5.75) were inflated by Anthropic revaluation gains tied to priced funding rounds (Series G in Feb, Series H in May). I found no Anthropic priced transaction in Jul-Sep 2026, and the IPO is reportedly after the November midterms, so I expect no large Anthropic gain in Q3. An unseen observable-price event is priced as an ~8% tail above 2.995. Market check: harness found nothing on Polymarket/Manifold, and my search found no Kalshi or bookmaker market.
calls.dossier:
- Amazon reports Q3 2026 (quarter ending Sep 30) on Oct 29, 2026 (MarketBeat, financecalendar).
- Consensus Q3 2026 diluted EPS: ~$1.96 (range $1.82-2.17, drillr); other sources $2.00-2.03 (Nasdaq/Barchart via inkl). Q3 2025 actual: $1.95, which included a ~$9.5B pre-tax Anthropic gain from the Sep 2025 Series F.
- Q2 2026 (SEC 8-K Ex 99.1, Jul 2026): operating income $27.5B (+43% YoY); net income $62.6B; diluted EPS $5.75; 10,903M diluted shares; $53.4B pre-tax non-operating income, mostly Anthropic. A further $42.0B unrealized AFS gain went to OCI, not net income.
- Q1 2026 diluted EPS: $2.78, inflated by an Anthropic revaluation after the Feb 2026 Series G at a $380B post-money valuation.
- Q3 2026 guide: net sales $197-202B; operating income $22.5-26.5B.
- Mechanics: Anthropic preferred-stock gains hit net income only on an observable price event (priced round or similar transaction). Series H ($65B at $965B post-money) closed May 2026, i.e. Q2. The employee tender at $350B ran Feb-Apr 2026.
- Searched and found no Anthropic priced round, tender or secondary dated Jul-Sep 2026. Draft S-1 was filed confidentially Jun 1, 2026. IPO reportedly targeted after the Nov 2026 midterms (Reuters via useluminix), at ~$2T. One source mentions a late-September prospectus; unconfirmed.
- Other non-operating items: Rivian mark-to-market and other equity revaluations each quarter; FX.
- Core EPS arithmetic: (operating income + roughly $0-1B net other) x ~0.83 / 10.9B shares. Operating income of $24B gives ~$1.83, $26B ~$1.98, $28B ~$2.13. Amazon has historically landed at or above the top of its operating-income guide.
- Resolves off the first reported EPS after Sep 2026, i.e. reported diluted GAAP EPS for Q3 2026, not consensus or adjusted figures.
- Event window: Q3 2026 report expected Oct 29, 2026; as of Oct 13 the quarter has closed and the report is pending.
- Markets: harness found none on Polymarket or Manifold; my search found no Kalshi or bookmaker market.
- Upside tail: an undiscovered Anthropic observable-price event in Q3 could add $1+ to EPS. Downside tail: an impairment or large equity markdown.

Core: op income guide $22.5-26.5B, Amazon usually beats the top of its range (Q2 was $27.5B); ~$27B pre-tax, ~20% tax, ~10.95B shares gives ~$2.0-2.1, consistent with $1.96-2.03 consensus. calls.reconciliation: Runs agreed on all core facts: Q2/Q1 EPS, Q3 guide, consensus, ~10.9B shares, and no Q3 Anthropic priced event. Factual dispute over Anthropic IPO timing (mid-Oct marketing vs post-midterms): unsettled without web access, but both readings put pricing in Q4, so it does not affect Q3. OpenAI $1.4T talks were reported late Sep with no Q3 close; treated as tail risk. Judgment disputes: tax rate (17-22.5%) and beat size. I took ~20% tax and a moderate beat, giving a median slightly below the runs. Upper escape is 7%, a bit below the runs' 8-10%, because none found evidence of a Q3 event. Carried forward the runs' reference class and a similar dispersion.
